entities.name: Shattered Sea
entities.description: Southeastern sea of the Terisian Isles, formed during the Thaw.

entities.name: Terisian Isles
entities.description: Isles formed when Terisiare was flooded.

entities.name: Kelsinko
entities.description: City at the bottom of the Shattered Sea.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: Mage who led a team trying to hold back the waters from Kelsinko.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: Plague-ridden vampire-haunted city swallowed by the sea.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Flooding over several decades during the Thaw.

events.summary: The Shattered Sea formed during the Thaw as meltwater rushed out of Terisiare's glaciers.
events.quote: The Shattered Sea came into being during the Thaw

events.summary: Jaya Ballard's team of mages failed to hold the waters back and Kelsinko's people fled to Yavimaya.
events.quote: They failed, and the city's inhabitants were forced to become refugees

events.summary: The rising sea swallowed the streets of Krov.
events.quote: eventually also swallowing the plague-ridden, vampire-haunted streets of Krov

relations.quote: Kelsinko lies at the bottom of the Shattered Sea.
